parsed.answer: This looks like a known problem: Windows Terminal crashing with an access violation in Microsoft.Terminal.Control.dll when a tab is dragged into another window to merge it. terminal#19383 reports the same crash on 1.22 when merging two windows by dragging a tab. Its WinDbg analysis pointed at AtlasEngine::PaintCursor on the render thread. A later comment on that ticket says the same failure bucket was seen on a newer build. terminal#17246 reports crashes and hangs on drag-merge, in Microsoft.Terminal.Control.dll and Windows.UI.Xaml.dll. The tickets don't give a workaround or a confirmed fix, and the crash is intermittent. As a practical measure, avoid drag-merging tabs between windows until it is fixed, and save any work running in other windows first, since a crash closes all windows. Add your report, with the 1.24.2605.12001 fault offset and the note that it still happens on 1.24, to terminal#19383. Share the crash dump through a private channel such as Feedback Hub rather than attaching it publicly, because it contains scrollback.
